I really wanted to love this, because you get SO MUCH STUFF for this price, however, my main reason for this purchase was the planner and the quality/resolution of the planner pages is horrible. 

You zoom in a reasonable amount (maybe a 25% zoom in?) and there is a grainy texture behind all the text/numbers. For example, you zoom in on any one of the daily planner pages and the word "Tuesday" in the top corner is crystal clear but the text "Today I'm grateful for..." text right below it is grainy and horrible quality. 

The one 2024 planner I downloaded also had a really goofy tab layout. You'd think it would go Dec 2023 and then Jan-Dec 2024, but it was Jan-Nov 2024, Dec 2023 and then Dec 2024, which really bothered my OCD brain. 

I will be purchasing a different planner set and not using this one, which is unfortunate.
